title: Long-term Evaluation of Percutaneous Endoscopic Caecostomy in Refractory Constipation
official: Monocentric, Non-interventional Study Evaluating the Long-term Outcomes of Percutaneous Endoscopic Caecostomy (PEC) in Patients With Refractory Chronic Constipation
summary: This observational monocentric study aims to evaluate the long-term effectiveness and tolerance of percutaneous endoscopic caecostomy (PEC) in patients with chronic refractory constipation. Follow-up data will be collected through phone interviews and standardized quality of life questionnaires.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adult patient
* Received PEC at CHU de Nantes
* Affiliated to French social security
* Non-opposition obtained

Exclusion Criteria:

* No PEC placement
* Protected adults or unable to respond
* Refusal to participate
